semiconductor_relevance: High — Sanwa Engineering specializes in the design and manufacture of automated systems for clean rooms in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Sanwa Engineering Corp. is a Taiwanese company focused on the design and manufacture of automated systems for LCD and IC clean rooms. With over 20 years of experience, they provide solutions such as EFEM and sorter automation, catering to process equipment manufacturers and semiconductor fabs.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Sanwa Engineering has a well-established presence in Taiwan, focusing on the semiconductor equipment market.
